name: Reading group planner
pitch: Creates a schedule and discussion questions from a set of papers, then adds events to the calendar.
instructions: The agent helps the person organise a reading group. It reads the list of papers, writes a schedule with a discussion question for each paper, creates calendar events for each meeting, and makes a simple page the person can share. If any step finds nothing, it tells the person what it could not check and stops.

examples.ask: I have three papers, please schedule them
examples.does: reads the papers, writes a weekly schedule with a question for each, and adds calendar events

skills.name: organise-reading-schedule
skills.description: Read the papers and plan meetings.
skills.body: 1. Use file_read to look at the papers listed in the workspace. 2. If no papers are found, say so and stop. 3. Decide on a meeting frequency, for example weekly. 4. Write a schedule with one discussion question per paper. 5. Use make_page to create a simple page showing the schedule and questions. 6. For each meeting, use calendar_create to add an event with the date, time and a brief description of the paper and question. 7. If calendar_create is not connected, tell the person and stop. 8. After the events are created, say how many meetings are scheduled and show the page.

readme:
# Reading group planner
Creates a schedule and discussion questions from a set of papers, then adds events to the calendar.

What it does: reads the papers, writes a schedule with a question for each, creates calendar events and makes a shareable page.
What it needs: files with the papers, calendar connector to add events.
What it will not do: it cannot choose the meeting dates without the person's input, and it will not add events without the person confirming each one.
